behavior =
  ! foil
  + field
    \ item=json key=str
    ^ either[str json]
    ?> (json/obj fields) item (./err "Expected a record")
    = matches fields.keep((\ e (equal[str] e.k key)))
    ? (eq matches.len 1) (./ok matches.at(0).v)
    | ./err "Missing or duplicate required field"
  + text
    \ item=json key=str
    ^ either[str str]
    < raw (behavior/field item key)
    ?> (json/str value) raw (./err "Expected a string")
    | ./ok value
  + duration
    \ item=json
    ^ either[str nat]
    < text (behavior/text item "duration")
    ?> (./some value) (nat/parse text) (./err "Duration must be a nonnegative integer string")
    | ./ok value
  + dependencies
    \ item=json
    ^ either[str row[json]]
    < raw (behavior/field item "depends_on")
    ?> (json/arr refs) raw (./err "depends_on must be an array")
    | ./ok refs
  + lookup
    \ key=str all=row[json]
    ^ either[str json]
    ? (eq all.len 0) (./err "Missing referenced record")
    % remaining=row[json] all found=json all.at(0) count=nat 0
    ^ either[str json]
    ? (eq remaining.len 0) (? (eq count 1) (./ok found) (./err "Missing or duplicate record ID"))
    < id (behavior/text remaining.at(0) "id")
    = next=json (? (equal[str] id key) remaining.at(0) found)
    = hits=nat (? (equal[str] id key) (add count 1) count)
    | _ remaining.drop(1) next hits
  + index
    \ key=str all=row[json]
    ^ either[str nat]
    % remaining=row[json] all position=nat 0
    ^ either[str nat]
    ? (eq remaining.len 0) (./err "Missing referenced record")
    < id (behavior/text remaining.at(0) "id")
    ? (equal[str] id key) (./ok position)
    | _ remaining.drop(1) (add position 1)
  + validate_refs
    \ refs=row[json] all=row[json]
    ^ either[str bool]
    % remaining=row[json] refs
    ^ either[str bool]
    ? (eq remaining.len 0) (./ok (eq 0 0))
    ?> (json/str id) remaining.at(0) (./err "Dependency IDs must be strings")
    < position (behavior/index id all)
    | _ remaining.drop(1)
  + validate
    \ all=row[json]
    ^ either[str bool]
    % remaining=row[json] all
    ^ either[str bool]
    ? (eq remaining.len 0) (./ok (eq 0 0))
    < id (behavior/text remaining.at(0) "id")
    < member (behavior/lookup id all)
    < duration (behavior/duration member)
    < refs (behavior/dependencies member)
    < valid (behavior/validate_refs refs all)
    | _ remaining.drop(1)
  + seed
    \ item=json
    ^ either[str nat]
    | ./ok 0
  + ready
    \ entry=either[str nat]
    ^ bool
    ?> (./ok value) entry (eq 0 1)
    ? (eq value 0) (eq 0 1)
    | eq 0 0
  + latest
    \ refs=row[json] all=row[json] table=row[either[str nat]]
    ^ either[str nat]
    % remaining=row[json] refs best=nat 1 complete=bool (eq 0 0)
    ^ either[str nat]
    ? (eq remaining.len 0) (./ok (? complete best 0))
    ?> (json/str id) remaining.at(0) (./err "Dependency IDs must be strings")
    < position (behavior/index id all)
    < end table.at(position)
    = nextComplete=bool (? (eq end 0) (eq 0 1) complete)
    | _ remaining.drop(1) (add best (sub end best)) nextComplete
  + finish
    \ item=json all=row[json] table=row[either[str nat]] target=str increase=nat
    ^ either[str nat]
    < id (behavior/text item "id")
    < duration (behavior/duration item)
    < refs (behavior/dependencies item)
    < start (behavior/latest refs all table)
    ? (eq start 0) (./ok 0)
    = extra=nat (? (equal[str] id target) increase 0)
    | ./ok (add start (add duration extra))
  + maximum
    \ table=row[either[str nat]]
    ^ either[str nat]
    % remaining=row[either[str nat]] table best=nat 1
    ^ either[str nat]
    ? (eq remaining.len 0) (./ok (sub best 1))
    < end remaining.at(0)
    ? (eq end 0) (./err "Dependency cycle detected")
    | _ remaining.drop(1) (add best (sub end best))
  + project_finish
    \ all=row[json] target=str increase=nat
    ^ either[str nat]
    % fuel=nat all.len table=row[either[str nat]] all.map((\ record (behavior/seed record)))
    ^ either[str nat]
    ? (eq fuel 0) (behavior/maximum table)
    ? (table.all((\ entry (behavior/ready entry)))) (behavior/maximum table)
    = next all.map((\ record (behavior/finish record all table target increase)))
    | _ (sub fuel 1) next
  + decide
    \ item=json all=row[json]
    ^ either[str bool]
    < id (behavior/text item "id")
    < member (behavior/lookup id all)
    < valid (behavior/validate all)
    < original (behavior/project_finish all id 0)
    < delayed (behavior/project_finish all id 1)
    | ./ok (eq delayed (add original 1))
  + apply
    \ input=json
    ^ either[str json]
    ? (equal[json] input jnull) (./ok (json/arr []))
    ?> (json/obj members) input (./err "Expected explicit records")
    = found members.keep((\ member (eq member.k "rows")))
    ? !(eq found.len 1) (./err "Expected rows")
    ?> (json/arr rows) found.at(0).v (./err "Expected a record array")
    ? (gt rows.len 128) (./err "Evaluation is bounded to 128 records")
    % remaining=row[json] rows.keep((\ item (equal[json] (view/field "id" item) (view/field "id" input)))) results=row[json] []
    ^ either[str json]
    ? (eq remaining.len 0) (./ok (json/arr results))
    = item remaining.at(0)
    ?> (json/obj fields) item (./err "Expected a record")
    = identity fields.keep((\ member (eq member.k "id")))
    ? !(eq identity.len 1) (./err "Every record needs an identity")
    < value (behavior/decide item rows)
    | _ remaining.drop(1) results.snoc((json/obj [(jkv "id" identity.at(0).v) (jkv "value" (json/boo value))]))
